id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID to use for this interface instance. This is used to refer to the interface in other components, platforms or lambdas.

*See also: [USB CDC-ACM Interface](https://esphome.io/components/usb_cdc_acm#configuration-variables)*

interfaces.docs:
**list**: List of CDC-ACM interface instances. Up to two are supported; at least one is required. Defaults to a single-item list which defines a single interface only.

*See also: [USB CDC-ACM Interface](https://esphome.io/components/usb_cdc_acm#configuration-variables)*

rx_buffer_size.docs:
**int**: Size of the USB receive buffer in bytes. Range: 1-65535. Defaults to `256`.

*See also: [USB CDC-ACM Interface](https://esphome.io/components/usb_cdc_acm#configuration-variables)*

tx_buffer_size.docs:
**int**: Size of the USB transmit buffer in bytes. Range: 1-65535. Defaults to `256`.

*See also: [USB CDC-ACM Interface](https://esphome.io/components/usb_cdc_acm#configuration-variables)*
